suspicion: Our Figure 5 reads are biased LOW: all three printed helper-lipid-free values (29, 44, 68) exceed ours (28.94, 43.59, 67.35).
retired_by: The four UNLABELLED minor y ticks, which took no part in the calibration, are predicted at 105.00, 75.03, 45.04 and 15.09 against the round 105/75/45/15 the authors drew and never printed - worst deviation 0.091 percentage points. The Lpf2k control reads 91.44 against a printed ~91, i.e. HIGH. A scale bias moves every one of these in one direction; these do not move. The three small gaps are the authors rounding their own numbers up in prose.

suspicion: bars.bar_top is broken: it refused the red bar of group 80 with a 241 px left/right flank disagreement while visibly sitting on an ordinary bar.
retired_by: The refusal was right and the WINDOW was wrong. Column x=410 carried 19 red pixels of JPEG colour ringing bled from the adjacent black bar, all of them within 20 px of the baseline, against 261 in every real bar column. Filtering a window's columns at half the window's maximum column count removes it; the bar then reads 85.25% with a flank delta of 0.0 px. The detector found a defect in its caller, which is what a refusal is for (error class 28).

suspicion: The x-axis break can be located as the widest gap in the bars' baseline footprint.
retired_by: Measured: the naked-mRNA-to-Lpf2k gap is 17 px and the last-blue-to-Untreated gap is 12 px, so 'widest gap' put the library boundary at x = 954 and swept two control bars into the library, giving 12 black windows where there are 11. Replaced by a rule that is a property of the figure's encoding - red and blue appear only on library members - and then TESTED by requiring 11 uniform windows in each of the three series.

suspicion: The cyclic benzylidene acetal's ring closure is a regiochemical choice: 1,1,1-tris(hydroxymethyl)ethane has three CH2OH groups and only two close the ring, and molecular formula cannot tell the pairings apart.
retired_by: The three CH2OH groups have IDENTICAL canonical rank (breakTies=False gives [1,1,1]), so all three pairings are the same constitution and there is no choice to make. Independently confirmed by make_reference.py's positive control, which writes the 2+1 arm split of 113 and 306 on the opposite nitrogen and still gets an exact InChIKey match on all eleven anchors.

suspicion: assemble.attach's check_stereo_preserved passing means the assembly is stereochemically sound.
retired_by: It means nothing here. assemble.stereocentres() returns {} for the O16CBA tail, while Chem.FindPotentialStereo returns TWO unspecified tetrahedral centres - the acetal C2 and the quaternary ring C5. They are para-stereocentres: neither is a CIP centre alone because each sees two constitutionally identical ring branches, but together they fix the cis/trans relationship that this paper's whole chemistry turns on. The guard is blind to the only stereochemistry in the molecule. Kept as an OPEN decision rather than silently worked around.
